properties.name: SpreadFactor
properties.comment: This value controls how damage from this warhead type will reduce over distance. The larger the number, the less the damage is reduced the farther the distance from the source of the damage.

properties.name: IsWallDestroyer
properties.comment: If this warhead type can destroy walls, then this flag will be true.

properties.name: IsWoodDestroyer
properties.comment: If this warhead can destroy wooden walls, then this flag will be true.
